user.title: Set up a panel
user.description: Install ha-paneld on a new panel or connect a panel that is already running it.

menu_options.install_usb: Install using USB on this browser

menu_option_descriptions.install_usb: Connect the panel by USB to this computer, not to the Home Assistant server.
menu_option_descriptions.install_or_upgrade: Let Home Assistant inspect and install a clean panel over Android Debug Bridge (ADB).
menu_option_descriptions.connect_existing: Add a healthy installation. A later integration version will manage updates after connection.

install_usb.title: Install using USB
install_usb.description:
[Open the USB installer]({usb_install_url}). Connect the panel to the device running this browser, not to the Home Assistant server. Use a browser with WebUSB support and enable USB debugging on the panel.

The experimental installer supports clean installations only. Existing installations are not overwritten. Afterwards, complete setup on the panel and return here to connect the existing installation. Submit returns to the setup menu.

install_or_upgrade.title: Install ha-paneld
install_or_upgrade.description: Before continuing, find the panel's IP address, keep physical access to its screen and enable network ADB on port 5555 using the [model-specific panel access guide]({panel_access_url}). Root access is not required. Enter the hostname or IP address below. Home Assistant first checks for an existing installation, then uses ADB only for a clean first installation whose exact release can be verified.

data_description.release_candidate: Choose the latest stable release or a published release candidate (RC) for testing. RCs may contain bugs. The default also resumes an existing job with its original release. When only resume is offered, no new stable installation is available. This does not upgrade an installed panel.

connect_existing.title: Connect an existing panel
connect_existing.description: Enter the hostname or IP address of a panel already running ha-paneld.

confirm_existing.title: ha-paneld is already installed
confirm_existing.description: A healthy ha-paneld {version} installation was found at {address}. Submit to connect it to Home Assistant. A later integration version will add update management. No installation will be performed, even if a release candidate tag was entered.

authorize_adb.title: Authorize Home Assistant on the panel
authorize_adb.description: The selected release includes a verified installation descriptor. Select Submit once to create or load a persistent ADB identity for this Home Assistant installation and offer its public key to the Android panel at {address}. On the panel, approve Android's Allow debugging prompt, then return here and select Submit again. Android may describe Home Assistant as a computer. Approval grants general ADB shell access while network debugging remains enabled; revoke it from the panel's developer settings. No APK is downloaded or installed at this step.

confirm_install_candidate.title: Confirm first installation

confirm_install_rc.title: Confirm release candidate installation

release_preview_only.title: Release cannot be installed automatically
release_preview_only.description: Panel {address} is eligible for further inspection, and release {version} ({tag}, SHA-256 {sha256}) was authenticated. This release has no signed installation descriptor, so Home Assistant will not create an ADB credential, download the APK, or change the panel.

install_result.title: Finish panel setup
install_result.description:
ha-paneld {version} was installed at {address}.

Submit to retry only the final read-only identity and health checks. No installation step will be repeated.

After Home Assistant adds the device, select Set up on the panel to connect ha-paneld to Home Assistant and configure the dashboard.

progress.installing: Installing and verifying ha-paneld at {address}. Leave this dialog open to finish automatically. You may close it and Home Assistant will keep the installation job running, but it cannot add the device until you reopen Settings → Devices & services → Add integration, select Panel Assistant, choose Install ha-paneld on a panel and enter the same address. After Home Assistant adds the device, complete ha-paneld's guided setup on the panel.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to a valid ha-paneld health endpoint.
error.invalid_address: Enter a hostname or IP address without a URL scheme or path.
error.invalid_install_address: Enter only the panel hostname or IP address. The installer uses ha-paneld port 8888 and ADB port 5555 separately.
error.install_resolution_failed: Home Assistant could not resolve this panel address. Check the address and local DNS, then try again.
error.install_resolution_timeout: Local name resolution timed out before the panel address could be pinned safely. Check local DNS, then try again.
error.install_too_many_addresses: This hostname resolved to too many addresses to pin safely. Use a dedicated local hostname or private IP address.
error.unsafe_install_target: Installation is allowed only to a private local IPv4 address or a unique-local IPv6 address. No ADB connection was attempted.
error.install_target_changed: The hostname no longer resolves to the same pinned panel address. No ADB key or installation was sent. Check the address and start again.
error.adb_unreachable: ha-paneld did not respond and Android Debug Bridge (ADB) could not be reached. Check that the address is correct, the panel is online, and network debugging is enabled, then try again.
error.adb_unauthorized: The panel still requires ADB authorization. Approve the prompt on the panel, then try again.
error.adb_still_unauthorized: The panel has not accepted this Home Assistant instance yet. Approve the ADB prompt on the panel, then try again.
error.adb_credential_error: Home Assistant could not safely load or persist its ADB credential. No panel change was attempted. Check the Home Assistant storage and logs before retrying.
error.installed_without_health: The ha-paneld package is installed but its health endpoint did not respond. This flow will not overwrite or repair it. Do not retry automatic installation; open ha-paneld on the panel or follow the provisioning safety and recovery guide linked from the integration documentation. After restoring a healthy installation, start again to connect it.
error.retained_or_ambiguous: The panel may contain a retained ha-paneld package record or its package state could not be proven absent. No panel change was made. Retry once if the connection was unstable; otherwise follow the provisioning safety and recovery guide linked from the integration documentation. Do not uninstall or reset the app without a verified backup.
error.incompatible: The ha-paneld package was not found, but the panel's Android SDK or processor architecture is not supported. No APK was downloaded or installed.
error.cannot_resolve_release: An install candidate was found, but Home Assistant could not resolve and verify the selected ha-paneld release. No APK was downloaded or installed. Check internet access and, if testing a release candidate, that the exact tag is published with its signed assets. No other release will be substituted.
error.invalid_release_candidate: Select an available release candidate from the list, or use the default stable/resume option.
error.install_release_conflict: An existing installation job owns this panel with a different release. Its version cannot be changed here. Select the default option to resume that job.
error.install_candidate_changed: The panel identity or clean package state changed after the preview. No installation job was created. Start again after checking the panel.
error.install_plan_rejected: The panel and signed release could not be bound into a safe installation plan. No installation job was created.
error.install_job_conflict: A different installation job already owns this panel identity. No second job was created.
error.install_receipt_error: Home Assistant could not safely load or persist the installation receipt. No new panel action was authorized.
error.install_finalization_busy: Another setup dialog is completing this panel. Wait for it to finish, then retry if needed.
error.install_finalization_retry: The installation completed, but a final read-only network, ADB, or health check is temporarily unavailable. Check the panel and retry; the installation will not run again.
error.release_catalog_unavailable: Home Assistant could not load published releases. Check internet access, then submit to retry or resume a saved job. You can also return to connect an existing installation.
error.release_catalog_empty: No eligible installation releases are currently published. Submit to check again or resume a saved job, or return to connect an existing installation.
error.release_selection_required: Release choices have been refreshed. Select an available release to continue; the resume-only option cannot start a new installation.

abort.preview_only_release: The authenticated release has no signed installation descriptor. No ADB credential was created, no APK was downloaded, and no panel state changed.
abort.install_cancelled: The installation was cancelled before an APK was installed. No Home Assistant entry was created. To try again, add the Panel Assistant integration and enter the same panel address.
abort.install_cancelled_after_staging_cleanup: The installation was cancelled and the staged APK was removed before installation. No Home Assistant entry was created. To try again, add the Panel Assistant integration and enter the same panel address.
abort.install_authorization_failed: Home Assistant could not safely load or validate its stored ADB credential. No APK was installed. Check Home Assistant's storage and logs, then add the Panel Assistant integration and enter the same address to try again.
abort.install_preflight_rejected: The panel no longer proved to be a clean, compatible installation target. No APK was installed. Correct the panel state described in the integration documentation before starting again with the same address.
abort.install_artifact_rejected: Home Assistant rejected the release download or staging operation before package installation. No APK was installed. Check Home Assistant's internet access, storage and logs, then start again with the same address.
abort.install_transport_failed: Home Assistant could not complete the pre-install connection, download or staging step. No APK was installed. Check the panel, network, Home Assistant internet access and logs, then start again with the same address.
abort.install_package_failed: Android definitively refused the APK and Home Assistant removed its staged file. No app or Home Assistant entry was created. Check the panel's compatibility and available storage before starting again.
abort.install_launch_failed: The APK is installed, but Home Assistant could not complete or verify the launch step. Do not retry automatic installation. Open ha-paneld on the panel or follow the provisioning safety and recovery guide linked from the integration documentation.
abort.install_health_check_failed: The APK is installed, but ha-paneld did not pass its health check. Do not retry automatic installation. Open ha-paneld on the panel or follow the provisioning safety and recovery guide linked from the integration documentation.
abort.install_ambiguous_mutation: An ADB staging, installation or launch operation may have changed the panel. Do not retry automatic installation, uninstall or reset the app. Follow the provisioning safety and recovery guide linked from the integration documentation.
abort.install_verification_required: The panel changed, but Home Assistant could not verify the installed package or clean up its exact staged file. Do not retry automatic installation, uninstall or reset the app. Follow the provisioning safety and recovery guide linked from the integration documentation.
abort.install_failed: The installer stopped with an unrecognized result. No Home Assistant entry was created. Do not retry automatic installation until you have checked the panel and the provisioning safety and recovery guide linked from the integration documentation.
abort.install_worker_stopped: The installer stopped and will not replay this job in the current Home Assistant process. Restart Home Assistant, reopen setup, and enter the same panel address to resume or receive a recovery result. No entry was created.
abort.install_recovery_required: Home Assistant cannot prove that it is safe to continue automatically. No entry was created. Do not retry automatic installation, uninstall or reset the app until you have followed the provisioning safety and recovery guide linked from the integration documentation.
abort.install_receipt_error: Home Assistant could not safely read the durable installation receipt. No entry was created.
abort.unknown: The setup flow lost its pending panel state. Start setup again.
